messages.subject: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

We want to raise a query about an invoice from a rental earlier in the year. We understand there is no deadline for disputing invoices, so we are bringing this up now. There are charges on it that we believe are incorrect and we would like them reviewed.

Please advise how to proceed.

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

Noted, I'll look into this. Could you send the invoice number so I can pull it up?

Regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Outi,

This is separate and urgent. One of our operators got an electric shock from the generator we have on hire from you. He touched the casing and got shocked. The unit needs to be taken out of service immediately. Please call me about this as soon as you can.

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting this. I've noted the incident and passed it on. Someone will be in contact with you shortly.

Regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Back on invoices. We also have a question about the invoice for the 1-tonne mini dumper rental. Can someone check that one as well?

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy
